 Versus

 Mr. Yogesh Bobade, Advocate h/f Mr. A.B. Hawale, Advocate for petitioner
 Mr. R.S. Wani, Agp for State
 ...

Coram : Smt. Vibha Kankanwadi &
 Hiten S. Venegavkar, Jj.
Date : 06th January, 2026

ORDER :
. Heard learned Advocate for petitioner.

The petition has been filed for following reliefs :
"(B) By issuing appropriate writ, order the impugned order / communication letter dated 12.08.2025 issued by Competent Authority / learned Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition, Jayakwadi Project, beed may kindly be quashed and set aside.

(C) By issuing appropriate writ, direction or order the respondents be directed to prepare fresh Award in respect of 2 926_WP_14443_2025 acquired land of the petitioner that is situated in Gat No.48 and 50 of village Belgaon, Tq. Georai, Dist. Beed as per the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013."

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Consequential prayers are also made at clause 'D' and 'E'.
However, it appears that at Exh. 'D' at page No.63 a communication was received to the Advocate for petitioner that revised Award has been prepared and demand for the amount has also been made.

When petitioner had the knowledge about preparation of Award, he ought to have applied for same and ought to have filed copy of said Daivwan Vitthalrao Bangar vs The Union Of India Through Its Secretary ... on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45585343/
1 Award.

entities.text: Daivwan Vitthalrao Bangar vs The Union Of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Instead of that present petition has been filed.
This is unnecessary wastage of judicial hours.
Learned Advocate ought to have taken care.
Now, he says that petitioner would apply for copy of Award.
2 Place the matter for further consideration on 06.02.2026.

( HITEN S. VENEGAVKAR, J. ) ( SMT.
VIBHA KANKANWADI, J. ) agd
